Title: HTC-27915: Power Supply - Reverse Polarity Protection

Steps.1: Review on the schematic and verify if the power inputs (Pins 29 & 36) have reverse polarity protection (Schottky diode).
Steps.2: Connect the hw_DAA to a DAA CS harness.
Steps.3: Connect the power supply source and multimeter to the hw_DAA using banana cables, a DC power supply and crocodile clips as shown in the attached diagram.
Steps.4: Switch on the power supply source.
Steps.5: Set 6.5V on the CH1 of the power supply source.
Steps.6: Limit the current to 100mA in the power supply source.
Steps.7: Turn on the CH1 of the power supply source.
Steps.9: Set up the multimeter as ammeter. Set it to Auto-Range, Run/Hold and DC Current.
Steps.10: Take the current value with the multimeter at power input.
Steps.11: Check that the current is almost zero, when 12V are connected to the hw_DAA across its inverted power input terminals.
Steps.12: Repeat the measurements with different voltages at the power supply source: 12V, 24V and 36V (using CH1 and CH2 of the power supply source connected in serial).
